question: How do you implement a debounce function in JavaScript?
explanation: debounce wraps a function so it only runs after a period of inactivity. Every time the returned function is called, it clears the previous timer (if one was still waiting) and starts a new one. This means if calls keep happening quickly, fn never actually runs — only once the calls stop for the full delay does the timer finish and fn finally execute with the most recent arguments. This is commonly used for things like search-as-you-type, so the search only fires once the user pauses typing instead of on every keystroke.
